scenario: WIBTA if I quit my job in my boss's third trimester or during maternity leave? | My boss recently told me that she is pregnant, and I have been slowly trying to find a new job for awhile now. There are two managers in my department (I am one of them) and the other one just quit. Her leave will be 5 months long and will span a busy period for us.
